signal: Magic Software completed its merger with Matrix IT in February 2026, forming a combined IT giant operating in 50 countries with over 6,000 customers.

email.body1:
Sherrie, saw Magic Software closed its merger with Matrix, now a combined group across 50 countries and 6,000-plus customers.

Merging two go-to-market motions usually multiplies the buying signals faster than ops can route them, so in-market accounts sit untouched while the data settles. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, turning signals into booked meetings: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for Magic Software off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sherrie, quick follow-up for Magic Software.

Post-merger, the bottleneck is usually latency: a signal fires, but it takes days to enrich, route, and act, so the account goes cold. Tightening that loop is where measurable lift lives, and our best practices alone tend to raise response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I would make first across the combined motion.
email.body3:
Sherrie, last bit of proof for Magic Software.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Magic Software's reply rate likely compares to other IT-services teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sherrie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action is not a priority while the two orgs integrate, no problem at all. Timing matters mid-merger, and I know data hygiene work keeps an ops team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Magic Software either way.
